terms.definition: One day on another world. A Moon sol is about 24 hours long.
A sudden flash of light and energy from the Sun.
Fast tiny particles from the Sun that can harm living things.
How much radiation the body has taken in. Lower is better.
Material that blocks radiation. Water and soil work well.
One unit of the outpost's limited electricity supply each sol.
The time a message takes to travel between Earth and the outpost.
The team on Earth that helps astronauts plan and stay safe.
